A menu has 4 regular sandwiches and 1 new sandwich. It also has 3 hot drinks and 2 cold drinks. How many sandwich-drink combinations are possible?
Hints: There are 4 + 1 sandwiches and 3 + 2 drinks;Multiply the totals
Solution: There are 5 sandwich choices and 5 drink choices, giving 5 × 5 = 25 combinations.
